justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/expr/CastExpr.java`, `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/expr/TypeExpr.java`, and `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/expr/Expression.java`. `CastExpr` is a small AST node (~170 lines) with only 2 fields (`type`, `expression`) and standard generated boilerplate: constructors, getters/setters, `clone`, `replace`, visitor dispatch, and `is/as/if/toCastExpr` helpers. It does not contain multiple domain responsibilities or a large set of bespoke methods; its structure is comparable to the similarly simple `TypeExpr` node and the generic casting framework in `Expression`, so there is no strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
